recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further source edits for FHIR-31791 would be redundant unless a later BR&R decision changes the status modifier policy for these resources.
issue_request: FHIR-31791 was a Published/Persuasive BR&R change request for R5 asking that status be marked as a modifier for the medicinal product resources, specifically the R4-era MedicinalProduct and MedicinalProductPackaged artifacts.
initial_application: The requested modifier metadata was applied before this reconciliation. Current reachable history shows PackagedProductDefinition.status gaining isModifier=true and the standard status modifier reason in explicit FHIR#31791 commit 0fd1d4b0d3. MedicinalProductDefinition.status carries the same metadata in current source, with blame through b749d02904 after the medicinal product rename/refactor path; all-ref history also contains an explicit FHIR#31791 MedicinalProductDefinition application commit.
additional_context: The current build no longer has active MedicinalProduct or MedicinalProductPackaged resource folders. source/fhir.ini actively builds MedicinalProductDefinition and PackagedProductDefinition, records their normative status, and includes R4-to-current name migration entries for the old medicinal product family. Jira search found only the seed issue for the status/modifier terms, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current StructureDefinition sources already mark MedicinalProductDefinition.status and PackagedProductDefinition.status as modifiers and include an isModifierReason explaining that the status can indicate a record should not be treated as valid.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the commit history that contributed to the current MedicinalProductDefinition status line during the medicinal product rename/refactor path; not needed as a separate decision for this seed.
